environment.gravity_source: main@245a785 reach_free environment; Human-owned benchmark gravity

derivation.nominalization: Force-free nominal operating point; backend task keeps its declared external forces unchanged.

algorithm.gain_source: augmented ZOH exponential + discrete Riccati equation

projector.reconstruction: segment mean curvature from principal joint angle / actual cell length; least squares on exactly integrated basis split at knots

algorithm.cost_semantics: Discrete stage weights: sum(delta_x.T Q delta_x + delta_u.T R delta_u). Same numeric diagonals as historical recipe; not exact continuous-cost discretization.
algorithm.weight_units: Q curvature entries: (m/rad)^2; Q rate entries: (m*s/rad)^2; R: 1/N^2; dimensionless stage cost

lifecycle.initialize: observe actual backend state; no actuator state

semantics.initial_state: named model coordinates; unspecified joints are zero
semantics.timing: control observations and force signals are interval-start/pre-step; saved state signals are interval-end/post-step
